title: Escape to Vietnam with Boat Ride to Tam Coc Caves
highlights: Step back in time as you explore Vietnam's rich history, cruise through Halong Bay, uncover Hoa Lu's history, and bike through its scenic landscapes.
Explore the historic Hoa Lu, Vietnam's ancient capital, home to the intricately carved temples dedicated to founding kings.
Venture through the countryside on two wheels as you cycle from Tam Coc to the enchanting Bich Dong Pagoda.
Cruise through Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site, surrounded by breathtaking limestone karsts and emerald waters.
overview:
About the tour:
Witness the vibrant tapestry of Hanoi, where ancient temples stand tall amidst French colonial architecture. Immerse yourself in the bustling night markets and explore the city's hidden charms. Your Vietnam trip wouldn't be complete without a cruise through the iconic Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its towering limestone karsts and emerald waters. For the adventurous soul, Ninh Binh offers a thrilling escape with its limestone caves and verdant landscapes. Indulge in delectable cuisine, from the fresh seafood of the coast to the flavorful dishes of the countryside. Experience the warmth of Vietnamese hospitality and create lifelong memories in this enchanting Southeast Asian gem, often chosen as a dream destination in Vietnam honeymoon packages.

know_before_you_go: Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Begin your Vietnam adventure as you arrive at the Noi Bai International Airport and get transferred to the hotel to check in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure by exploring nearby attractions on your own. Visit Ngoc Son Temple, dedicated to General Tran Hung Dao, a Vietnamese hero. Admire the iconic red The Huc Bridge leading to the temple and enjoy serene views of Hoan Kiem Lake. Conclude your day by returning to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi at 02:00 PM

days.title: Excursion to Ninh Binh
days.desc: Begin this day by onboarding your pre-booked transfer for a day trip to Ninh Binh city. Visit the Hoa Lu temples, the ancient capital of Vietnam, once home to the Dinh and Le Dynasties, after whom many attractions in the area are named. Afterwards, explore the limestone caves of Tam Coc on a boat ride (at an extra cost) from Hao Lu. From there, enjoy a cycling adventure to Bich Dong Pagoda before getting transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
days.desc: Get ready for a cruise adventure after checking out of the hotel and getting transferred to Halong Bay. Upon arrival, embark on a Halong Bay cruise at Tuan Chau Harbour. Stop by Ti Top Island and Pearl Farm Village to enjoy recreational activities like kayaking and swimming. Also, learn how to cook Vietnamese cuisine onboard. Conclude your day with an overnight stay in the cabin as the cruise glides through the limestone karst (hollowed rock formations) and pristine waters of Halong Bay.

items.title: Check-in at Halong Royal Palace Cruise
Halong Bay Overnight Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Board the cruise for Halong Bay from Tuan Chao Harbor and check-in into your cabin. Enjoy the scenery while sipping the welcome drink. Reach Tiptop Island and relax. 
Explore Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like Kayaking and swimming in the bay. Return to the cruise. Afterwards, join the cooking classes on Vietnamese-styled food. 
Enjoy the overnight stay at the cruise.

days.title: Transfer to Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: As a new day dawns, continue your Halong Bay adventure by engaging in a Tai Chi (martial art) lesson and visiting the largest caves of Halong Bay, the Surprise Caves (also called the Sung Sot Cave). Following that, deboard the cruise, get transferred to Hanoi and check in at the hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure by exploring attractions like Ho Chi Minh's Mausoleum and the Temple Of Literature on your own. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi
items.desc:
Enjoy your journey by joining the Tai Chi lesson on the cruise. Explore the other parts and islands of the Halong Bay. 
Experience a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest caves in the Halong Bay and admire it's scenic beauty. 
Return to the cruise, relax and enjoy before reaching Taun Chan Bay
